newsitem.title: FRANCE: French rescue services scour Alps for plane.
newsitem.headline: French rescue services scour Alps for plane.

text.p: French rescue services were searching the Alps on Thursday after reports of a possible plane crash, officials said.

"Witnesses early this morning reported seeing an explosion and a light in the sky," an official at the Prefecture in Annecy said. He said 150 para-military gendarmes and rescue workers had been mobilised without finding any trace of a plane.
A helicopter was also sent to the region near Annecy but was hampered by bad weather.
Despite the mystery report of an explosion, officials said there were no reports of any planes missing in the region. And no known planes had filed flight plans taking them over the region.
